label: Phone Status
description:
Adds a native-looking phone connection status icon to the Karoo status bar, right next to the built-in status icons. The icon mirrors the system status bar automatically: white on the home and launcher screens, black during a ride, and it turns red with a slashed phone the moment the phone connection drops, so you notice at a glance.

The connection state is read from the Karoo system phone service (the same source the built-in status bar uses), so no Bluetooth permission is required. The indicator restarts automatically after a reboot.

Note: This is an independent, open-source project and is not affiliated with Hammerhead Navigation Inc. or SRAM.
releaseNotes: Bolder red "phone disconnected" indicator, tighter status-bar alignment, and a setup screen that re-checks permissions on every launch.
